agents.result: I stopped partway because of a conflict: an "Airspace hold" hook says agent-b is renaming the same parameter the other way, from `categories` back to `category_filter`, and it blocked my three edits to the test calls in `tests/test_basic.py`. The rename is done in `src/flask/helpers.py` (signature, body and docstring) and in `docs/patterns/flashing.rst`, but the tests still use `category_filter=`, so `test_extended_flashing` fails (1 failed, 490 passed, 3 skipped). Should I keep `categories` and update the tests anyway, or undo my changes and leave the name to agent-b?

I added `get_flashed_errors()` at the end of `src/flask/helpers.py` and exported it from `src/flask/__init__.py`, and the tests pass (491 passed, 3 skipped); it calls `get_flashed_messages(False, ["error"])` with positional arguments because a hook said another agent is renaming `category_filter` to `categories`, and this form works with both names.
